description: This file defines the interface for asynchronous Redis client operations, including context structures, callback types, and function prototypes for connecting, disconnecting, and executing commands asynchronously.

classes.name: redisAsyncContext
classes.description: Structure representing an asynchronous Redis connection context, including connection state, callbacks, and event hooks.

methods.name: redisAsyncConnect
methods.description: Establishes an asynchronous connection to Redis at specified IP and port.

methods.name: redisAsyncConnectBind
methods.description: Establishes an asynchronous connection to Redis with source address binding.

methods.name: redisAsyncConnectBindWithReuse
methods.description: Establishes an asynchronous connection with address reuse.

methods.name: redisAsyncConnectUnix
methods.description: Establishes an asynchronous connection to Redis via Unix socket.

methods.name: redisAsyncSetConnectCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function to be called upon successful connection.

methods.name: redisAsyncSetDisconnectCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function to be called upon disconnection.

methods.name: redisAsyncFree
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with the async context.

methods.name: redisAsyncHandleRead
methods.description: Handles read events for the async connection.

methods.name: redisAsyncHandleWrite
methods.description: Handles write events for the async connection.

methods.name: redisvAsyncCommand
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous command with a formatted string and variable argument list.

methods.name: redisAsyncCommand
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous command with a formatted string.

methods.name: redisAsyncCommandArgv
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous command with argument vector.

methods.name: redisAsyncFormattedCommand
methods.description: Sends a formatted command with specified length.
